messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm sorry if I had you
worried about me. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0a 00}I feel
100% better now!
{07 14 00}It's all because you brought
me that {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 0d 00}I don't know what I'd do
without you, {04 1f 00}!
Thank you so much!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Vabandust, kui ma panin
sind muretsema. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0a 00}Tunnen end
nüüd 100% paremini!
{07 14 00}Ja see kõik sellepärast, et
sa tõid mulle {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 0d 00}Ma ei tea, mida ma sinuta
teeksin, {04 1f 00}!
Suur aitäh!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks a bunch for getting
me {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00} the other day.

{07 0a 00}I think I'm totally over
that cold now, {04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Suur aitäh, et sa mulle
hiljuti {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00} tõid.

{07 0a 00}Ma arvan, et see nohu on
nüüd täiesti läbi, {04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I feel so happy! {01 00 00 05 00}Thanks to
all of my friends,
I'm totally recovered!
{07 0d 00}It was a bad cold, but your
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00} saved me from
becoming a snot factory!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen nii õnnelik! {01 00 00 05 00}Tänu
kõigile mu sõpradele
olen ma täiesti terve!
{07 0d 00}See oli halb nohu, aga sinu
{ff 00 00 07}rohi{ff 00 00 00} päästis mu tativabriku
saatusest!
